Title: Transcriptome of RKO cell (DMSO control), rep 1
Characteristics: tissue: Colon | cell line: RKO | cell type: colorectal carcinoma cell | treatment: DMSO
Extraction: Total RNA was isolated from RKO cells using TRIzol reagent according to the manufacturer's instructions. RNA integrity was verified by agarose gel electrophoresis. RNA purity and concentration were assessed using a NanoDrop spectrophotometer, with acceptance criteria of OD260/280 ≥ 1.8 and OD260/230 ≥ 2.0. | Sequencing libraries were constructed from 1 µg of high-quality total RNA per sample. Messenger RNA was enriched using oligo(dT) magnetic beads. The NEBNext Ultra RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina was used for library preparation following the manufacturer's protocol, which includes mRNA fragmentation, first and second strand cDNA synthesis, end repair, dA-tailing, adapter ligation, and PCR amplification. The final cDNA libraries were size-selected for fragments of 250-300 bp and their quality was assessed.
Processing: Quality Control: Raw sequencing reads (fastq files) were subjected to quality assessment using FastQC. | Alignment: Reads were aligned to the human reference genome (GRCh38/hg38) using HISAT2 with default parameters. | Quantification: Gene-level read counts were generated from the aligned BAM files using FeatureCounts. | Differential Expression: Differential expression analysis was performed on the count matrix using DESeq2 in R. | Genes with an absolute log2 fold change ≥ 1 and an adjusted p-value < 0.05 were considered differentially expressed. | Assembly: hg38 | Supplementary files format and content: File: readcount.csv Format: Tab-delimited text in Excel (.csv) Content: Raw integer read counts for genes (ENSG IDs) across 6 samples (C1, C2, C3, E1, E2, E3)
